To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we can provide scalable transactions in the cloud, even in the case of server failures and/or network partitions.

(1) CloudTPS is the first transactional system that scales up to 100+ servers in the Amazon cloud; (2) CloudTPS scales up to 80 nodes in Amazon cloud and 40 nodes in a local cluster, with an average latency of less than 10 ms per transaction and a maximum latency of less than one second; (3) CloudTPS provides a transactional layer for web applications that is transparent and scalable, without requiring any changes to existing application logic
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and implementation of a scalable transactional system that can run on top of the cloud data stores and provide full ACID guarantees to the applications.
the design and implementation of scalable transaction managers for web applications.
the design and implementation of a scalable transaction manager for web applications in the cloud.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the CloudTPS approach is an effective solution to provide ACID transactions for web applications in the cloud.
CloudTPS is able to provide ACID guarantees for transactions on top of scalable NoSQL data stores, with a linear scalability in the number of nodes.
CloudTPS is the first transactional system that scales linearly with the number of nodes in the cloud.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CloudTPS is the first system which provides a scalable solution for ACID transactions for web applications in the cloud.

we are able to provide a scalable, reliable and fault-tolerant transactional system for the web.

scalable transaction processing can be achieved in cloud data stores with a small performance overhead, which is negligible for most of the applications.
